# Example spec — fixture

A stand-in living spec. It exists so this case's spec home is REACHABLE: the
point of the case is a record that cannot name its spec, with reachability
held constant and out of the way.

## Requirements

- **R1** — The lifecycle shall hold exactly one living spec per product.
- **R2** — When an intent arrives, the lifecycle shall classify it against the
  whole living spec.
